description: A director of student services must approve a proposed middle-school peer-tutoring program and finalize its supervision, digital platform, student matching, and consent procedures, with input from the tutoring teacher, school counselor, technology coordinator, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The middle school has proposed a six-week peer-tutoring program for students in grades 6 through 8.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan calls for two adult supervisors, Google Classroom for session communication, student-selected tutor pairings, and paper consent forms collected before the program begins.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Singh has authority to approve the program and set its operating requirements.
shared_context.S4: The school routinely holds a planning roundtable before launching a student program, and Dr. Singh asks the teacher, counselor, technology coordinator, and family liaison for relevant information before signing the approval.
shared_context.S5: If a participant's response is unclear or cannot be recorded, the roundtable procedure requires Dr. Singh to ask that participant to restate the information before the approval is finalized.

PF1.text: The finalized roster contains 18 student tutors, and the school's supervision rule permits one adult to supervise no more than six tutors in an active tutoring session; Mr. Lee received the roster from the activities office yesterday, but the draft plan still lists the preliminary staffing estimate.

PF2.text: The counselor's student-support review found two active no-contact restrictions involving prospective tutors and students seeking tutoring, so pairings must be assigned and monitored by the counselor rather than selected by students; Ms. Brooks completed the review this week, but the restrictions are recorded only in confidential counseling files.

PF3.text: Google Classroom is not approved for this program's student-to-student communication, while the district-managed Microsoft Teams education environment is approved and retains the required school records; Mr. Ortiz confirmed the platform settings with district IT this week, but the technology field in the draft application has not been updated.

PF4.text: For this program, family consent must be entered in the student information system before a student participates, and the district has approved translated electronic forms in addition to paper forms; Ms. Walker confirmed the procedure with the family-engagement office this week, but the draft still describes paper collection without an SIS entry.

acceptance_conditions: The program must be approved with three adult supervisors.
Microsoft Teams must be used for program communication.
The counselor must assign and monitor tutor-student pairings.
Consent must be entered in the student information system before participation.
A formal pairing safeguard must record counselor assignment and monitoring replacing student-selected pairings.

content_checks.C4: 'counselor' in decisions['matching_method'] and 'assign' in decisions['matching_method'] and 'pair' in decisions['matching_method'] and ('monitor' in decisions['matching_method'] or any('monitor' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C5: 'SIS entry' in decisions['consent_record'] or 'student information system' in decisions['consent_record']
content_checks.C6: any('counselor' in c['detail'] and 'pair' in c['detail'] and 'assign' in c['detail'] and 'monitor' in c['detail'] and ('student-selected' in c['detail'] or 'self-select' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The finalized roster of 18 tutors changes the required supervision level from the draft's two adults to exactly three adults under the six-tutors-per-adult rule.
The two active no-contact restrictions change pairings from student-selected matches to counselor assignment and monitoring and require a formal safeguard for those pairings.
The district platform confirmation changes the communication platform from Google Classroom to approved Microsoft Teams.
The family-engagement procedure changes consent from paper collection alone to an SIS entry required before participation.
